_metadata.description: A valid .d sidecar paired with its (untampered) source .d, but the sidecar's type tag has been changed from 'timsim.provenance.v0' to 'timsim.provenance.mzml.v0'. The payload schema still has the .d shape (d_content_hash, ground_truth_hash) so the mzml parser MUST reject it for missing required mzml fields (mzml_content_hash). The reference verifier raises MalformedSidecar via the mzml payload validator, mapped to SIDECAR_ERROR (3).
